title: A Fantastic Taste of Seville – Great Guide, Food and Local Gems!
text: We had a fantastic food tour in Seville! Our guide was brilliant, spoke perfect English and had a wealth of knowledge about the local food, culture and history. The selection of stops was excellent, with a lovely variety of places to visit and delicious food to try along the way. It was a great way to discover some local gems and experience Seville beyond the usual tourist spots. The whole tour was enjoyable, relaxed and informative. Highly recommended for anyone wanting to explore Seville through its food!

title: Very Special Tour
text: Great tour with an excellent variety of dishes. Our guide was fantastic, making the whole experience really special. We visited a local market, sampled many delicious local products, and learned about them. We also stopped at a couple of tapas bars, where we enjoyed several dishes and drinks. There was plenty of food to go round! 10/10 would recommend!
